purpose: Independently verify if the already-developed WSP101 DEV paired causal task provides any headroom against a fully source-informed broad-grammar symbolic model.
source: research/contrib/chatgpt/WSP-101/paired_fixture.py at parent commit, DEV contexts 0..7 only
visible_model_control: Enumerate all 4 operator families x 6 wiring shifts x 4 phases = 96 candidate visible programs. Keep only candidates exactly matching all public passive tuples, no imported oracle parameters.
hidden_model_control: Enumerate all 3 possible trigger actions x 2 delayed-effect modes = 6 hidden program hypotheses; simulate publicly specified delayed h0/h1 transitions without reading implementation oracle hidden members.

frozen_outcomes.DEV_SYMBOLIC_CEILING: All eight DEV passive sets reduce 96 visible hypotheses to exactly one; for all 16 (context,mode) worlds the eight-action policy reduces six trigger/mode hypotheses to exactly one.
frozen_outcomes.DEV_SYMBOLIC_HEADROOM_OPEN: At least one context retains more than one passively consistent visible program or one live world leaves multiple hidden programs consistent with active histories.
frozen_outcomes.DEV_INVALID: Use of oracle internals, source-mode labels or public/reserved original worlds by symbolic learner; duplicate/overflow action steps, data-hash drift, malformed observations.

sources_and_controls: Separate symbolic source program with no import of paired_fixture, rank, private oracle objects or fixture truth
Collector may instantiate public observe_world endpoint per DEV fixture and pass only passive rows plus public active records
Matched, fixed active starts and eight actions across both hidden modes and all contexts
Positive delayed intervention and passive/ablation fixture controls remain untouched
stop_on_ceiling: Do not spend original first-use or model training on this already-ceiling DEV task; design a genuinely harder mechanism family and source-identifiability check first. Preserve symbolic ceiling even if weight programmer can learn it.
science_status: NOT A SCIENTIFIC CLAIM; prior manual DEV analysis motivated this audit; trained recurrent/SSM baseline not run
architecture: No Yggdrasil / Wingless / TTT-Hybrid native substrate changes
authority: Research-only WSP101 branch; no merge, accepted ref edit, loop/controller, scheduled task, paid API, model inference or donor reuse
